evidence.reason: The preflight completion-budget logic explicitly requires two strictly advancing completions after one start, and refuses only service_type == "simple". It does not check RemainAfterExit. A bounded Type=oneshot service with RemainAfterExit=yes becomes and stays active after the first start; restarting it from the restored timer is a no-op, so the second completion cannot occur. This is an implementation gap in existing intended preflight behavior, not a new requirement. Add a preflight refusal for the active-after-first-invocation topology while leaving saved-service restoration separate.
